Name: Forge to Fight - Craft Weapons Boots Rings and Upgrade Tools
Author: Syanide23
Description: Adds an anvil purchasable from Clint that allows the player to craft weapons, boots, rings, and upgrade certain tools. Galaxy weapons, Infinity weapons, spouse weapons (ex. Haley's Iron), and Monster Slayer rewards aren't craftable to keep in line with vanilla. Tools can be upgraded but require three times the amount of resources as paying Clint to do so. Some recipes are default, but others are learned through leveling up the combat skill. Also adds the Galaxy Slingshot and the Rapier as craftable as they were previously unobtainable.
